1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2020.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2020

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lapan ratus sembilan puluh

tujuh juta lapan ratus dua puluh dua ribu ringgit (RM897,822,000) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan

Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2020 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2020.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2020

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding eight hundred and ninety-seven million eight

hundred and twenty-two thousand ringgit (RM897,822,000) from the Social Security

Fund for the expenditure on administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the

year 2020 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 264,230,000

Supplies and services 248,274,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 84,966,000

Other expenditures 132,492,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 167,860,000

Total 897,822,000

Made 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXIII]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
